name: Dither-TS-TW
title: Dither
blurb: Dithered wave pattern with retro pixelated color quantization.
description: React Three Fiber scene with FBM wave animation combined with Bayer dithering post-processing. Supports wave color, speed, frequency, pixel size, and optional mouse interaction. Uses Effect Composer for post-processing.
use_when: Retro or lo-fi aesthetic backgrounds where dithering and color reduction create intentional visual degradation.
avoid_when: High-fidelity designs or when smooth animations are required; dithering creates visible banding.
a11y: Canvas-based, no semantic content. Mouse interaction is optional. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
